jobs.title: 3D Computer Vision Researcher – Arlington, VA
jobs.description_text: Advance 3D Vision Research from Algorithms to Open Source Applications. In this position, you’ll research and develop algorithms for photogrammetry, camera calibration, registration, and 3D reconstruction from images and video. Current projects emphasize aerial and satellite imagery, with opportunities to adapt these capabilities to new challenges and data domains such as underwater imagery and synthetic aperture radar. Your work will contribute to open source applications and frameworks including TeleSculptor, KWIVER, and Danesfield. You’ll also explore how 3D vision can support broader computer vision problems such as object detection and tracking, change detection, super resolution, and video compression. Kitware partners with government R&D agencies, branches of the U.S. military, members of the Intelligence Community, and commercial organizations ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies. You’ll have opportunities to collaborate directly with customers, participate in field tests and demonstrations, publish novel work, and apply state-of-the-art artificial intelligence approaches to real-world national security challenges.

By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. About the role As a Gas and LNG Market Research Analyst, you will play a key role in shaping Kpler’s short- to medium-term supply and demand intelligence across global LNG and regional natural gas markets. Working within our Insights team, your research, modeling, and client-facing commentary will directly empower energy traders, utilities, and market participants to navigate evolving gas balances with clarity and confidence.

jobs.title: Marketing & Communications Manager
jobs.description_text: Join the Future of Robotic Biomanufacturing! Multiply Labs is a robotics company on a mission to solve a significant bottleneck in modern medicine: the manufacturing of life-saving advanced biologics, from gene and cell therapies to antibodies and more. Today, these therapies are produced through manual, labor-intensive processes. Costs are extremely high—often $500K–$2M per patient—limiting access to only a small fraction of those who need them. As product complexity increases and the cost of failure and scientific labor rises, the industry is shifting toward automation. Robotics and AI are making automated biologics manufacturing feasible, reliable, and economically scalable. We believe the future of biomanufacturing is robotic—closed, automated, and scalable—ensuring critical therapeutics are accessible to every patient who needs them. Why This Matters We don’t just build robots—we’re building the essential infrastructure for next generation biologics. Our technology enables biopharma companies to scale production without redesigning their science, reducing regulatory hurdles and lowering costs so these treatments can reach more patients. jobs.title: Account Executive - Commercial, Spotify Technology
jobs.description_text: Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments. As an Account Executive on our Commercial team, you will drive new business for Spotify Technology. You'll focus on companies with fewer than 1,000 employees, where sales cycles typically run from weeks to a few months and success depends on a repeatable, scalable sales motion. You'll manage a high volume of opportunities, work with one or a small group of decision-makers (often a hands-on engineering leader or CTO), and move deals efficiently from the first conversation to close. You'll also help shape the playbook that enables our commercial business to grow. You'll collaborate with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to create a seamless customer experience. Your ability to quickly understand customers' technical needs and connect them to clear business value will be key to your success.

jobs.description_text: Royalty Operations owns the operations behind Spotify’s royalty process across music, audiobooks, lyrics, and creator content. As our business grows more complex, we’re focused on staying accurate and on time while getting faster and more flexible through scripting, Gen AI, and agentic workflows.

In this role you will work with a set of core label partners and artists. This role has a strong focus on launching innovative partnerships and initiatives and you will drive activations that enable, educate, and unlock new opportunities for our partners and Spotify. jobs.title: Bid Coordinator
jobs.description_text:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The Bid Coordinator is the organizational backbone of the bid team. Working alongside Bid Managers and Bid Specialists, this role makes sure every bid runs to a rigorous, well-managed process, so that deadlines are met, contributors know what is expected of them, and nothing falls through the cracks. This is a process and project coordination role rather than a content or strategy role. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive: someone who enjoys building order out of complexity, keeps many moving parts on track at once, and is comfortable following up with colleagues across the business to keep work moving. It is a strong entry point for someone looking to grow a career in bid management.

Responsibilities: 

  • Bid Planning and Scheduling Support
    • Support Bid Managers in building bid plans that work backward from the submission date, including milestones, review gates, internal deadlines, and buffer time. 
    • Set up and maintain bid trackers, schedules, and responsibility matrices (e.g., RACI) for each pursuit.
    • Keep plans up to date as timelines shift, and flag schedule risks to the Bid Manager early.
  • Tracking, Follow-Up, and Accountability

jobs.title: Director, Bid Strategy & Pricing
jobs.description_text:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive. 

The Director, Bid Strategy & Pricing (“Bid Director”) leads how Lyft Urban Solutions identifies, shapes, and wins new business. This role brings together commercial strategy, business intelligence, demand planning, and bid management in one function. Working as a strategic partner and deputy to the Head of Commercial Strategy & Delivery, the Bid Director owns the full pursuit lifecycle, from market strategy and pre-tender capture through bid submission and handover to delivery. We're looking for a strategist who is equally strong commercially, technically, and financially, and who leads people and cross-functional teams with confidence.

As a Business Development Manager at Xsolla you will be responsible for researching, understanding, and selling Xsolla's products and solutions to clients in Global. You will take on the operating rhythm of a team that is growing to 24 people across three regions, so the VP's time goes to event strategy, quality control and team performance. As this is a global role, some out-of-hours working will be required. Occasional travel may be required. At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

 

What you’ll do at Jamf:

 

The Inside Account Executive is a key member of the EMEIA sales team, helping existing customers and channel partners understand how they can make the management and the security of their Apple devices robust and easy. The role works with the extended sales team to hit individual targets as well as contributing to the overall MEA sales goals.

 

This role is offered as hybrid, with the expectation to be in the office in Amsterdam Zuid 3 days per week. We are only able to accept applications for those based in the NL and have sponsorship to live and work in the NL #LI-Hybrid

jobs.title: Sales Account Executive - Enterprise
jobs.description_text:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for an Account Executive to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to the Regional Director in the Sales and Go-to-Market department. jobs.title: Internal Communications Internship
jobs.description_text: About the role Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality. As our Internal Communications Intern, you’ll join our Marketing & Communications team and help keep colleagues across SkyNRG informed, connected and engaged. Working closely with our PR & Communications Manager and teams across the business, you’ll create engaging content, support internal campaigns and events, and help improve the channels and tools we use to communicate. Your Responsibilities Content creation: Draft and publish newsletters, intranet articles, announcements, interviews, employee stories and leadership updates. Employee engagement: Support internal campaigns, company events and town halls that connect and engage colleagues across SkyNRG. Channels & tools: Maintain internal communication channels and content calendars and help improve the processes and tools behind them. Collaboration: Work with teams across the organization to gather information and turn it into clear and engaging communication. Insights & improvement: Monitor engagement and use insights to continuously improve our internal communications. Your profile You recognize yourself in the following: Current Bachelor’s or Master’s studies in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, Business or a related field, with enrollment for the full duration of the internship. jobs.title: Finance & Risk Internship
jobs.description_text: About the role Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality. As a Finance Intern, you will support the Finance team in day‑to‑day financial operations and reporting, while gaining hands‑on experience in a scale-up environment. During this internship, you will work closely with experienced finance professionals and collaborate with teams across the business. You will contribute to improving financial processes, supporting reporting and compliance activities, and helping ensure accurate and timely financial information. This role offers exposure to both operational accounting and business-facing finance in a purpose‑driven organization. Your Responsibilities: Financial operations: Support daily finance activities, including reviewing bookings, assisting with month-end tasks and helping ensure financial data is complete and accurate. Month end support: Assist in the preparation of the monthly financial closing process by supporting reconciliations, checks, and documentation under guidance of the Finance team. Audit & compliance support: Assist with preparations for the annual audit and help ensure documentation is in place to support compliance with Dutch GAAP, VAT, and corporate requirements.
